name: International Anti-Corruption Day Run 2026: Run For Dad
short_description: International Anti-Corruption Day Run 2026: Run For Dad is on Saturday 5 December 2026 at Suan Luang Rama IX Park in Bangkok, over 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and a 3 km VIP walk.
ai_summary: International Anti-Corruption Day Run 2026: Run For Dad is a charity walk-run on Saturday 5 December 2026, held for International Anti-Corruption Day and Thailand's National Father's Day. It is organised by JOG&JOY, and part of the proceeds go to the Anti-Corruption Foundation's campaigns and to the Suan Luang Rama IX Foundation. The races are a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km mini marathon, a 5 km fun run and a 3 km VIP walk. The RUNLAH listing places it at Suan Luang Rama IX Park.

faqs.question: How much does the Anti-Corruption Day Run cost?
faqs.answer: The race.thai.run entry page lists the 21.1 km half marathon at THB 850, the 10 km at THB 600, the 5 km at THB 500 and the 3 km VIP walk at THB 1,500. Postal delivery of the race pack costs an extra THB 70 per runner. The 21.1 km and 10 km runners get a timing chip.

faqs.question: Where do runners collect the race pack?
faqs.answer: Runners who did not choose postal delivery collect their pack on Thursday 4 December 2026 from 11.00 to 18.00. The collection point is the JOG&JOY counter on the third floor of Seacon Square, Srinakarin Road. Runners must show an original ID card with their order number.
